files_changed.Sources/PlatformMac/StateRootSession.swi: new package StateRootSession.retainingAuthority(_:) -> any RecordFileDestinationGuarding. It returns a private immutable AuthorityRetainingDestinationGuard that holds the session and the wrapped guard and delegates both admit methods unchanged. The concrete type is not exposed, and there is no raw lease accessor, queue, registry, budget or protected-path list. The session owns no writer or guard, so there is no cycle.

regression_test.name: AppStateHarnessTests.testAHeldDiagnosticWriteKeepsTheRootLeasedAfterEveryOwnerLetGo
regression_test.shape: Built from the existing app composition and fixtures. holdTheAppLogOpen holds a fresh file-log writer at its open through appLogHold/HoldingAppLogGuard. The Quit then settles .completed around it. The harness drops the app and its own session, and the test waits until the AppState is released. A production bootstrap probe (createRootIfMissing false) must then be .failure(.busy). After appLogHold.release(), rootReacquires(within: leaseCloseBound) must succeed, and the held witness line must be in the log file. No production test hook.

limits: A writer stuck on hung I/O now keeps the root's lease until the write ends or the process exits, as 0017 requires. In tests this fails loudly through leaseCloseBound or the probe.
